target_customer: Physician expert witnesses and medical-legal firms, next TPAs, insurers and law firms handling injury claims
problem: Clinicians spend hours or days reading thousands of pages of records to reconstruct a patient history for a claim. Elithia agents build cited, verifiable timelines.
business_model: B2B software for experts and firms (pricing not public)
product_category: AI medical record review for claims and litigation

founders.name: Sarthak Jain
education: MIT Sloan MBA, left to start Elithia
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; sole listed founder, team size 1.

competitors.name: EvenUp
competitors.what: Demand letter and medical chronology automation for personal injury firms
competitors.traction_then: described as most adopted by firm count in one review

competitors.name: Supio
competitors.what: Source-linked medical chronologies with expert verification for plaintiff law

competitors.name: Wisedocs
competitors.what: Medical record review for carriers and medical evaluators with clinician validation

technical_complexity.rationale: Reasoning across conflicting medical evidence with page-level citations needs careful engineering and review loops, but builds on current LLMs.

defensibility.rationale: Expert relationships and trust in defensible output help, but EvenUp, Supio and others already serve the adjacent market.

market_need_then: The company cites $64.1B of US workers compensation payouts in 2023 and says 70+ physician experts use the product; these are self-reported.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found; name-meaning pages give conflicting unsourced readings.

outcome_analysis: Elithia is an active Fall 2026 solo-founder company with no outcome yet. The founder's quant finance background and early sales to physician experts and medical-legal agencies are the main signals. The medical chronology market already had funded players, so the wedge into insurers and TPAs will matter.
notes: No funding found in any source. Company site says it is incorporated in the UK while YC lists San Francisco. Customer counts are self-reported. Competitor sources are 2026 vendor roundups, loosely dated.
